source_duration.Evidence basis: National passenger-entry restriction and October1 travel permission define a policy segment. They do not establish matched gate-by-gate physical closure.
source_duration.Qualification: National passenger policy envelope, not physical impermeability. Cargo exemptions remained. Monitor reports Katuna entry denial shortly before midnight 21 March, ahead of national 22 March midday effective time. Gulajo/Golajo and Mount Zeu temporarily admitted DRC asylum-seekers 1–3 July 2020 and closed again 3 July; this is an interruption for that class only. October 1 marks general leisure/business reopening, not separately verified universal asylum admission. Dates describe the policy envelope; October1 is not coded as an observed universal border reopening.
